brief:
美国 10 月 CPI 环比上涨 0.4%，虽低于 9 月的 0.6%，却高于经济学家预期的 0.3%，叠加美联储官员沃勒表态将支持 12 月至少加息 25 个基点，金价在 4000 美元附近维持跌幅、美债遭遇抛售，市场对"通胀黏性+重新收紧"的定价明显升温。通胀数据暂时压过 AI 行情：美股因数据走弱，但亚洲股市受 CoreWeave 超预期财报提振上涨，显示资金仍在 AI 交易与宏观风险之间来回切换。个股层面冷热分化剧烈——软银因美国数据中心项目 37 亿美元减记、录得 70 亿美元亏损，股价一度跌 11%；Anthropic 则被曝寻求 1.4 万亿美元估值 IPO。中国 10 月 CPI 同比上涨 0.7%、PPI 上涨 5.7%，前 10 个月外贸增速回升、进博会意向成交超过 850 亿美元，但铜价高企正在挤压下游加工企业的利润。风险偏好整体收缩，摩根士丹利称全球股票对冲基金以十多年来最快速度削减风险敞口，巴西政府准备下周向国会提交财政方案，意大利银行业则公开反对未来三年额外 70 亿欧元的增税计划。

Top5：

1. 美国 10 月通胀放缓不及预期 —— 环比 0.4% 高于预测，12 月加息押注升温，金价与美债同步承压。https://www.ftchinese.com/story/001111329
2. 软银录得 70 亿美元亏损、股价跌 11% —— 数据中心项目减记与 AI 估值回落，让这家科技投资巨头近两年来首次净亏损。https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-11/softbank-group-shares-drop-10-after-booking-7-billion-loss
3. Anthropic 寻求 1.4 万亿美元估值上市 —— 较 5 月私募轮的 9650 亿美元大幅抬升，成为华尔街 AI 热情的试金石。https://www.ftchinese.com/story/001111328
4. 中国 10 月 CPI 同比涨 0.7%、PPI 涨 5.7% —— 同期外贸增速回升、进博会意向成交超 850 亿美元，内需与出口呈现温和修复。https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE9fWVB1MEJrOWhScVhabkh1cTh5bjI0cGVZR21mcmNnNXpSMU5kU3AxR3hUdEZ3emVaV3FaVHVqSkJDVGhHVkNKWnpVcG4yQV9lMnJtNE9OWnR6RlhIVTZ0NFpGalF0ODNnaVBfajY2WkZfejFZaXozcWxvWmI?oc=5
5. 全球股票对冲基金以十年来最快速度降风险 —— 摩根士丹利称 11 月初出现广泛平仓，AI 与利率双重不确定性促使机构收缩。https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-11/hedge-fund-risk-retreat-largest-in-a-decade-says-morgan-stanley

items.title: Indonesia to Cut 300 More Tightly Held Stocks From Benchmark
items.summary: Indonesia’s bourse will classify an additional 300 stocks to its high shareholder concentration list, leaving a third of its index members ineligible to stay in its benchmark, as it seeks to boost market transparency.

items.title: China Copper Crunch Puts Industry on Defensive as Costs Soar
items.summary: China’s copper crunch is squeezing activity and margins at the firms that shape the metal into wires, rods and tubes for use in products from cables to electronics and consumer goods.

items.title: Asian Stocks Rise on AI Enthusiasm, Bonds Slide: Markets Wrap

items.title: Hedge Fund Risk Retreat Largest in a Decade, Morgan Stanley Says
items.summary: Global equity hedge funds cut risk at the steepest rate in more than a decade through the first week of November as a widespread unwind gathered steam, Morgan Stanley prime brokers wrote in a note dated Tuesday.

items.title: Lula Team Readies Brazil Fiscal Plan in Bid to Calm Market Jitters
items.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s economic team is preparing to send proposals to Congress by next week aimed at showing investors how his government intends to meet fiscal targets in the coming years, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Gold Holds Loss Near $4,000 on Hot US Inflation, Fed Remarks
items.summary: Gold maintained losses after a high US inflation print and hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve officials reinforced bets for an interest rate hike in December.

items.title: Traders Who Rushed to Bonds as Haven Get Rattled in Reversal
items.summary: A recent influx of bullish positioning across the US bond market just got smacked, as comments from a pair of Federal Reserve officials and fresh evidence of sticky inflation increased the odds of interest-rate hikes, sending Treasuries into a tailspin.

items.title: SoftBank Group Shares Drop 11% After Booking $7 Billion Loss

items.title: 美国民主党控制国会对乌克兰意味着什么？
items.summary: 鉴于美国的外交政策仍掌握在特朗普手里，一些民主党议员寻求利用其拨款权和监督权来加强对乌克兰的支持，同时加强对俄罗斯的制裁。
